ranked.headline: Single-cell snapshots and trajectories are modeled as dynamic regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend pseudotime and snapshot analyses toward time-varying driver, network, and optimal-transport models of cell state.

ranked.headline: Sequence models dissect motif syntax governing chromatin accessibility and methylation
ranked.summary: Interpretable sequence models now resolve determinants of chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, and enhancer activity directly from DNA sequence.

ranked.headline: Protein LM embeddings enable sequence-only binding affinity and interface prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work shows sequence-derived protein language model embeddings now support binding affinity, epitope, and complex-structure prediction.

ranked.headline: Inferring asymptomatic carriers and lineage proportions from routine surveillance data
ranked.summary: Routinely collected clinical, wastewater, serological and mobility data are increasingly paired with mechanistic and statistical inference methods.

ranked.headline: Prioritizing noncoding variants and RNA isoforms beyond gene-level units
ranked.summary: Variant interpretation is moving from genes and genomic loci toward individual RNA molecules and isoforms, with regulatory and transcript-level tools now…

ranked.headline: Microbial sequence annotation linked to host, structural and metabolic context
ranked.summary: Large-scale microbial resources are being annotated with host, structural and metabolic context to link taxa to disease and function.

ranked.headline: Contrastive and transport-based alignment bridges unpaired and spatial omics modalities
ranked.summary: Unpaired and cross-platform spatial and single-cell data motivate alignment methods that avoid barcode pairing or feature correspondence.

ranked.headline: Computational recovery of cell-level biology from sparse and aggregated measurements
ranked.summary: Recent work applies deep learning and statistical models to denoise, integrate, and deconvolve single-cell data from sparse or pooled inputs.

ranked.headline: Variant-conditioned deep learning across regulatory, coding and population genetic tasks
ranked.summary: Recent work encodes zygosity, genotype and variant effects directly in learned genomic models across mutation, expression, splicing and disease tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational tools infer cell identity and spatial gene expression from tissue data
ranked.summary: Imaging platforms and H&E-based models now predict single-cell types and spatial expression, with new benchmarks guiding method choice.

ranked.headline: Graph and foundation-model representations predict expression and regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair graph structure or optimal transport with foundation-model embeddings for transcriptomic prediction.

ranked.headline: Simulations show condensate hardening and lipid-guided early oligomer assembly
ranked.summary: Recent MD studies resolve how condensates harden, membranes guide oligomerization, and ApoC-II stabilizes lipoprotein lipase domains.

ranked.headline: Simulation and NMR methods map dynamic binding and allostery in disordered proteins
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend MD, NMR, and Markov state modeling to disordered and phase-separating protein targets.

ranked.headline: Long-read and targeted sequencing resolve genome assemblies, isoforms, and 3D chromatin
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce targeted, haplotype-resolved, and structure-aware methods for genome and transcriptome analysis.

ranked.headline: Graph-based representation learning on EEG, fMRI, SEEG and structural connectomes
ranked.summary: Learned representations of brain connectivity graphs now span EEG-fMRI fusion, SEEG seizure detection, and structural connectome latent models.

ranked.headline: Deep learning for brightfield and fluorescence microscopy segmentation and detection
ranked.summary: Weakly supervised, synthetic-data, and metric-aligned training methods target annotation scarcity in microscopy and histopathology imaging.

ranked.headline: Reproducible pipelines standardize spatial, multi-omics, and network omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication package spatial, microbial multi-omics, and network-medicine analyses as end-to-end, reproducible workflows.

ranked.headline: Higher-order topology is used to compare brain networks and map synergistic interactions
ranked.summary: Higher-order topological and combinatorial methods are now applied to transcriptomic and fMRI data to probe brain network organization.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence models now guide protein design and hybrid sequence generation
ranked.summary: General-purpose LLMs and multimodal inverse folding now extend protein design beyond sequence-only conditioning.

ranked.headline: Accurate genomic representation underpins methylation, haplotype and lineage inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie methylation, Y-haplogroup, somatic haplotype and lineage inference to the accuracy of the underlying genomic representation.

ranked.headline: Software tools for bacterial methylation, microbial variant ranking and metagenomics
ranked.summary: Nanopore modification data, microbial variant prioritization, and reproducible metagenomic pipelines are now being packaged as usable tools.

ranked.headline: Shrinkage and copula models for high-dimensional omics regression and marker selection
ranked.summary: Sparse and shrinkage-based estimators are being tailored to interaction detection, discrete omics outcomes, and spatial transcriptomics.

ranked.headline: Curated and network-based resources link molecular features to cancer biomarkers
ranked.summary: Multi-omics, microbiome, and literature-derived resources now encode disease features as networks to prioritize candidate biomarkers and hub genes.

ranked.headline: Network-structured inference of reticulate gene exchange and virus-host links
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a Hi-C benchmark move microbial evolutionary and metagenomic inference toward explicit network and reticulate structure.

ranked.headline: Parameter-driven state transitions in mathematical models of disease onset
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply bistability and state-transition models to protein aggregation, glioblastoma initiation, breast cancer incidence, and lifespan limits.

ranked.headline: Accelerating fragment binding prediction via MD, neural networks, and solvent modeling
ranked.summary: Recent JCIM work targets speed and accuracy bottlenecks in fragment docking, binding-mode elucidation, and virtual screening.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and multi-lab data constrain models of biological temporal dynamics
ranked.summary: Longitudinal, multi-lab, and multi-omics datasets are now feeding tensor, penalized, and calibration frameworks that fit biological dynamics.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes and banded alignment cut memory for large sequence workloads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method target memory and runtime bottlenecks in sequence search, alignment, and genomic workflow parallelization.

ranked.headline: Omitted epistasis distorts GWAS null statistics; molecular QTL atlases broaden scope
ranked.summary: Expanding association analysis to expression noise and plasma metabolites raises the stakes for the validity of GWAS null test statistics.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks predict toxicity, synergy and antiparasitic activity from molecules
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs graph neural networks with fingerprints, descriptors, and image encodings for bioactivity, toxicity, and synergy prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking DIA single-cell proteomics workflows and pooled IP-MS interaction mapping
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks DIA single-cell informatics workflows while pooled IP-MS with sparse recovery aims to scale protein-protein interaction mapping.

ranked.headline: Deep models predict RNA and protein modification and interaction sites
ranked.summary: Four November 2025 papers pair learned sequence or graph representations with contrastive or capsule objectives for RNA and protein site prediction.

ranked.headline: Debiased benchmarks and ESM-2 models sharpen antimicrobial peptide discovery
ranked.summary: Debiased datasets and explainable attribution are being applied to peptide and antimicrobial predictors to improve their reliability.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic inference benchmarking and alignment strategies for viral genome trees
ranked.summary: November 2025 work targets tree annotation, inference benchmarking, and alignment design for transmission-related phylogenetics.

ranked.headline: Conditioning generative models on target, pocket, and expert priors for molecule design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend generative design beyond prior-only sampling to pocket, target, and expert-feedback conditioning.

ranked.headline: Demography confounds Ks-based WGD inference; fusions and coupling mark genome divergence
ranked.summary: Simulation, karyotype-level, and genome-wide coupling analyses now separate demographic, structural, and gene-flow effects on lineage divergence.

ranked.headline: Extended MD sampling links ligand binding to allosteric coupling across distant sites
ranked.summary: Extended MD sampling and Markov state models now tie allosteric networks to laccase substrate selection and p53 Y220C stabilizer activity.

ranked.headline: Neural models for biomolecular dynamics, backbone generation, and ligand koff prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply learned representations and generative models to protein dynamics, backbone design, and binding kinetics from structural data.

ranked.headline: Tools render gene loss, RNA pseudoknot layers, and ancestral recombination graphs
ranked.summary: Three new packages turn detection and rendering of gene loss, RNA pseudoknots, and recombination graphs into usable tools.
